t: Erbauer ECCD18-Li 18V combi drill delivers versatile drilling and screwdriving performance for demanding trade tasks. Suitable for plumbers, electricians and DIYers, the compact and lightweight cordless power tool features a length of 165mm and a weight of 1.4kg, allowing access into tight spaces and reducing user fatigue during prolonged use. Brushless motor technology ensures efficient power delivery and longer tool life, while 3-in-1 multi-function allows rapid switching between hammer, drill and screwdriver modes. Also equipped with a 13mm keyless metal chuck for quick 1-handed bit changes, suto spindle lock and a trigger-activated LED work light to illuminate dark work areas. Keep Cool thermal management system prevents battery overheating for reliable runtime during heavy-duty applications. Part of the EXT one battery system, where one battery can run multiple tools. Includes a belt clip for easy carrying. Supplied with 2 batteries, charger and carry case.
